**GRÖBNER-SHIRSHOV BASES FOR THE COXETER GROUPS**

*OF THE TYPES G2, F4, E6, E7 AND E8*

14 pp, 5 sections.

**Abstract.** It is known that the finite Coxeter groups are classified in terms of Coxeter-Dynkin diagrams. The authors are mainly interest in the Gr¨obner- Shirshov bases of finite Coxeter groups. In this paper, the authors obtain the Gr¨obner-Shirshov basis for Coxeter group of type E8, while giving simpler Gr¨obner-Shirshov bases for the Coxeter groups of the types E6, E7. The new presentations of En, n = 6, 7, 8 which are given in this paper has enormous effects in reducing the amount of calculation.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Preliminaries; Author contributions; References
